title: slopvac v3 word blocklist
description: A list of words a project refuses, each with a part of speech and a reason. The opt-in vocabulary check reads it; it is off unless `terms.blocklists` or `[vocabulary] path` names a file. The file may be TOML, JSON or YAML (`.toml`, `.json`, `.yml` or `.yaml`); the file suffix picks the format. Semantics are specified in docs/contract/plugins.md. Owner: slopvac-8l4.2.4.

BlocklistEntry.description: One refused word. The word is trimmed and lower-cased on load. A word and part of speech pair appears once.

pos.description: Part of speech. The values are case-sensitive and load as their long form: the lowercase short and long forms, and the spaCy tags NOUN, VERB, ADJ, ADV, ADP, CCONJ, SCONJ, PRON and DET.

reason.description: Why the word is refused. Required: an entry with no reason cannot be reviewed.

replacement.description: A note on what to write instead.
